description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 09.03.2020 to 15.03.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification (General) issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new rates of exchange for customs duties and rescinds a previous notification. This content involves regulatory matters and compliance requirements for customs operations, specifically falling under the category of legal/regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
